mapper.select: SELECT r.role_code FROM sys_role r INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = r.id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND r.status = 1 AND r.deleted = 0

SELECT DISTINCT p.permission_code FROM sys_permission p INNER JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON rp.permission_id = p.id INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = rp.role_id INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND p.status = 1 AND p.deleted = 0 AND r.status = 1 AND r.deleted = 0
SELECT DISTINCT u.username FROM sys_user u INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.id WHERE ur.role_id = #{roleId} AND u.deleted = 0
